meta.title: Oracle Playground
meta.tagline: Two hands, two thrusters, a hangar full of things that break.
meta.description: A Linux-native VR physics sandbox. You fly Oracle-style: each controller is an independent thruster. Point a hand, squeeze the trigger, go that way. Two hands together is SuperSonic-style Iron Man flight; one hand is torque and ballet. The hangar is a materials lab — ice, rubber, metal, wood, glass — plus shatterable crates and a buoyancy pool. Built so a human and an AI agent can both play and restock the room, on desktop or in a headset.
meta.author: Jonathan Korstad + Hermes

custom_mechanics.name: Oracle Dual Thrusters
custom_mechanics.description: Each hand is an independent rocket. Trigger magnitude scales thrust along that hand's forward (-Z). Both hands together translate; a single hand adds torque when apply_at_hands is on. Grip multiplies thrust (turbo) and drains booster fuel. Ported from SuperSonic handleFlightInput onto a Jolt RigidBody.
rules: Left trigger applies force along left-hand aim
Right trigger applies force along right-hand aim
Grip multiplies thrust by turbo_multiplier (~3.8) while booster fuel remains
Booster fuel drains while turbo is held and recharges otherwise
Optional upright stabilizer applies torque toward world-up
Desktop maps Q/LMB and E/RMB to virtual hands parented to the look camera
interactions: Thruster forces collide the body with hangar props, ramps, and water
High linear velocity shatters destructible crates
Water buoyancy + drag fight thrusters while submerged

custom_mechanics.name: Material Lab
custom_mechanics.description: Spawnable cubes with authored PhysicsMaterial profiles so friction, bounce, and density are playable, not theoretical.
rules: wood: medium density, shatterable when flagged destructible
glass: low density, high bounce, shatterable
interactions: Oracle flight uses the same Jolt world as every cube

custom_mechanics.name: Agent View
custom_mechanics.description: Deterministic viewport dump so a Linux agent can see what the player sees. Stand-in for Meta XR Operator.
rules: Capture is the active camera (desktop or XR)
Later phases may attach a VLM caption beside the PNG
interactions: Hermes reads the PNG via vision_analyze or a future oracle-playground skill

environments.name: Oracle Hangar
environments.visual_description: A vast charcoal hangar with a matte concrete floor, warm sodium work lights, and a long ice lane down one wall. Opposite the ice: a rubber bounce pit, a metal scrap stack, a wood crate pyramid, and a glass sculpture. A rectangular indoor pool sits at the far end, teal and slightly choppy. Color palette: charcoal, warm amber, teal water, scuffed concrete, hazard-yellow railings.
environments.audio_mood: Quiet HVAC rumble, distant metal ticks, water lapping, thruster whoosh when flying.

ambiance.lighting: Warm key from hangar bays, cool fill from the pool caustics, soft bloom.
ambiance.particles: Dust motes in light shafts, spray when hitting the pool fast.
ambiance.sky: Not visible. Dark industrial ceiling with skylight strips.

player.visual_description: A compact flight rig: dark capsule body, two glowing thruster gauntlets. In VR the body is mostly implied; the hands are the star.
